newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all weakened by crude, bar fuel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all weakened by crude, bar fuel.

text.p: NWE oil products were all knocked sharply lower on Friday bar fuel as crude fell.
Naphtha cargoes fell $5 to $175/$178 cif after a sharp drop in crude futures and a pair of weaker cargo trades on Thursday.
Gasoline barges fell $2 to $194/$195 fob for Eurograde, with even weaker deals late in the day as NYMEX unleaded futures lost more than three pct at one point and the US arb started to shut.

High sulphur fuel barges picked up on buying by one major, who collected more than 15,000 tonnes at $83 and $83.50. Cargo markets were lifeless. Gas oil lost up to $6 a tonne as tumbling futures and slightly easier premiums pulled prices lower.
